name: eBay used AMD Instinct MI210 64GB PCIe card
price_basis: USED, bare passive PCIe card. $4,180 = midpoint of the $4,000-4,369 ask band captured 2026-10-03..14. 64 GB HBM2e, 1600 GB/s, gfx90a. ASKING price, not sold. PERISHABLE-FIGURE STAMP: OBSERVED 2026-10-14. RE-VERIFY BY: 2027-01-14.
lead_time_basis: lead_time_weeks is null because this is a secondary market priced per listing.
export_control_regime: EAR 3A001 or EAR99 (CDNA2 gfx90a; check against 3A090 thresholds at purchase) + EAR 744.23 / 744.6 party screening
export_control_note: CDNA2 part; verify ECCN at purchase because advanced-computing thresholds can attach to higher-end Instinct parts. General EAR plus party screening applies.
notes: Fair price per GB but priced OUT of the sweet spot: 64 GB / 1.6 TB/s crosses into used-A100-80GB-PCIe territory ($12k is the next rung up, and MI210 is half the bandwidth). gfx90a is fully supported on the ROCm 10 matrix - no fork needed, unlike gfx906/gfx908. Passive PCIe, 300 W, IF-bridge optional. No direct llama.cpp measure found; ~2x MI100 memory, gfx90a supported upstream.
